## What to build

Byobu formatting with one-command rollback and re-enable. Deliver the complete operator behavior through the shared Wake controller and terminal boundary. Owner: ecochran76, coordinated by primary agent. Delivery: validated integration branch; no production deployment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Explicit enable projects compact type/state labels and colours through public CLI/API/MCP.
- [ ] Durably capture managed options before first write, distinguishing unset/inherited/explicit originals and namespace identity.
- [ ] One-command rollback disables reapplication and restores exact original settings with readback; reenable retains baseline and saved policy.
- [ ] Repeated commands and partial failures are honest and retryable; stale identities never affect another namespace.
- [ ] Installed owned tmux namespace verifies names, sessions and unrelated settings preserved.
